_comment: Spoken-form overrides applied ONLY to the text sent to the speech engine.
The written scripts in scripts/ are never changed.
IMPORTANT: the engine silently strips macrons, so 'Pakaraka' and 'Pākaraka'
produce identical audio. Long vowels must be spelled out here to be heard.
Add or remove entries after listening to audio/00_name-check.mp3, then re-run build.py.
Entries are applied longest-first, whole-word, case-sensitively.
